item.title: LETTERS: Illegal arrests
item.description: What if the Kansas Legislature would come up with a law that would allow law enforcement officials to write up and sign an illegal piece of paper, and then go bust down your door, arrest you as a citizen for no reason regardless of political affiliation, haul you off to jail, and hold you for 48 hours without being charged for any crime? You would laugh your heads off, right? This is America. Nothing like that could ever happen here. Maybe in a fiction novel or the communist Soviet Union, but no
